item.title: Michigan State hockey fans rally around late Dan Sturges at fundraiser
item.description: Michigan State hockey fans, friends, and community members gathered at One North Kitchen Bar and Grill to honor the late Director of Hockey Operations Dan Sturges and support his family with a fundraiser.

item.title: Hundreds gather for Mid-Michigan Women's Expo at Lansing Center
item.description: The Mid-Michigan Women's Expo returned to the Lansing Center this weekend, bringing hundreds of women-focused vendors, authors and makers together to discover new products, get fashion and beauty advice, taste-test fresh food and connect with small businesses.
